features.title: AI by readiness
features.description: A chart of clean energy technologies at each stage of readiness, showing how many are AI-driven, with an insight comparing research and scale.

features.title: AI in Great Britain
features.description: A chart of AI-driven clean energy technologies grouped by how close they are to use in Great Britain (in use, trials, planned, not yet, not known), with each technology's details and an insight.

features.title: Security timeline
features.description: A timeline with the security field on top and each other field below, counting landed and outlook milestones by period, so you can see when security work arrived beside the technologies. Select a bar to compare a period's milestones; with an insight.

features.title: Coming next
features.description: The outlook milestones grouped by the year they are expected to become real-world change, soonest first, with AI for clean energy marked. Select one for its expected gap from research beside its field's recent gap; with an insight.
